tasks.task: Scope the teardown and read the owner's context

items.when: When the owner names a competitor and the link, market and focus need confirming in one message
When the owner's own store has no current org context for the briefs to fit
When a vague ask needs turning into one clear research question before collecting
When the owner is unsure which rival to study and needs a quick profile of each

tasks.task: Collect public evidence into a cited bundle

items.when: When a full teardown starts: run order, collector, Meta sampling, report, check and render
When press, funding or founder interviews add context the store itself does not show
When the report should render in the competitor's own colours and fonts

tasks.task: Read the pixels, apps and tools behind the store

items.when: When the collector's pixel and app scan needs reading as a growth stack
When you need to explain what each detected app category does for their sales
When pixel and server-event signals need reading without calling them live campaigns

tasks.task: Sample and rank the competitor's Meta and Google ads

items.when: When the Ad Library sample and Google transparency results need ranking by run length
When an Ad Library export needs counting by format, age, page and awareness stage
When the live ads need sorting into types so the team can study each kind
When ad claims need separating what was seen from what is guessed

tasks.task: Classify creative angles and find the untested gaps

items.when: When the long-running winners need their angle, format, offer and landing page recorded
When ads need grouping by theme to rank the gaps worth testing
When the owner wants gaps and starter briefs scored from pasted competitor ads
When one competitor angle should become several original angles for the owner

tasks.task: Decode the offers, price ladder and subscriptions

items.when: When the catalogue evidence needs turning into a price ladder and offer system
When a free-shipping or bundle threshold needs testing against typical order sizes
When their subscribe-and-save terms need judging against what the owner can afford
When the owner asks which of the rival's offer types to test first
When the entry product, core range and premium anchor need reading as one ladder

tasks.task: Read the conversion path and ad landing pages

items.when: When product pages, hidden offer pages and the cart path need reading from the evidence
When a landing page their ads send traffic to needs its conversion choices named
When the rival's store needs setting beside the owner's on channels, prices and messages

tasks.task: Read retention, reviews and creator programmes

items.when: When email, SMS, loyalty, reviews and affiliate tools in the evidence need reading as a loop
When a detected email or SMS tool needs explaining as a likely flow, labelled as inference
When partner-page ads or affiliate apps point to a creator programme worth describing
When public reviews and comments show what buyers praise and complain about

tasks.task: Read search demand, SEO and AI answers

items.when: When autocomplete, sitemaps, YouTube and llms.txt evidence need reading as search strategy
When search overlap, content depth and brand presence need comparing with the owner's site
When the owner has Ahrefs and wants the keywords the rival ranks for and they do not
When you need to see whether AI assistants name the rival or the owner for shopper questions

tasks.task: Trace the pitch over time and map the white space

items.when: When Wayback snapshots show how the homepage pitch and hero product changed
When the lanes need a grid of where nobody is strong and where to stop fighting
When the owner needs one corner of the market they can own against this rival
When several rivals' messages need comparing to find words nobody owns
When the rival's choices need reading as a position with activities that support it
When the engine, the loop and each lane are ready to write from the report template
When each claim needs checking against the quote in its source
When the owner also wants category context, kept apart from the teardown's evidence
When a big call rests on the teardown and needs the counter-arguments written down

tasks.task: Check the report against its evidence and render it

items.when: When the report is drafted and needs citations, inferences and unknowns reviewed before delivery
When the rendered page must match the competitor's captured look at phone width
When the report reads generic and needs the stock AI phrases and layouts taken out

tasks.task: Brief each agent on what to take and where to win

items.when: When the lane map is ready and each agent needs one paste-ready brief
When each brief needs checking for the right agent, a number, a deadline and no copying
When a brief needs clear checks and stop rules for the agent that picks it up
When the creative brief should become full production briefs by funnel stage
When many briefs overlap and need merging into one ranked list of who does what

tasks.task: Plan the owner's moves for the next 30 days

items.when: When the report needs its 10 ranked moves built from the strongest gaps
When the owner wants the 30 days laid out as what to push and which offers to run
When the rival is much bigger and the plan needs a model the leader cannot copy

tasks.task: Compare two to four competitors lane by lane

items.when: When several rivals are torn down and need a table of who wins each lane
When each rival needs a card with product, pricing and buyer views side by side
When the category is crowded and the gap none of the rivals fills must be found

tasks.task: Report what changed at a competitor this month

items.when: When a dated re-run must be compared with the last one for new ads, launches and prices
When the owner wants the monthly change report kept on a schedule
When monthly changes add up to a battle card that needs refreshing

helpers.when: When the owner needs the whole market or category sized rather than one rival taken apart
When the ad findings become a Meta test plan with budgets in the owner's own account
When winning competitor angles need turning into the owner's own original concepts
When the rival's price ladder raises a pricing decision for the owner's range
When the search findings need a page and keyword plan for the owner's site

gaps: Meta ads come only through the owner's official Meta connector or their own export; without one the Meta lane is an unknown.
No paid traffic, revenue or ad spend data is used; the library has no source that makes these facts, so they stay proxies.
The library has no item that reads a D2C catalogue or Shopify app stack end to end; the kit's own tools do that work.
